findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Command injection in subprocess calls
 * @description Using untrusted input in subprocess calls can lead to command injection
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/command-injection
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-078
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("subprocess").getMember(["call", "check_call", "check_output", "run", "Popen"]).getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember(["system", "popen"]).getACall()
select call, "Potentially dangerous command execution that could lead to command injection if arguments are user-controlled."
findings.hypothesis: Command injection via subprocess calls with user-controlled input

message.text: Potentially dangerous command execution that could lead to command injection if arguments are user-controlled.
